description: A four-step sequencer in which each step has both a voltage and a length, so the pattern can be uneven.

params.text: How many clock pulses the first step lasts.
The voltage of the first step.
The voltage of the second step.
How many clock pulses the second step lasts.
The voltage of the third step.
How many clock pulses the third step lasts.
The voltage of the fourth step.
How many clock pulses the fourth step lasts.
Chooses what a high level at the EFFECT jack does: up skips the next step, middle holds the gate high through the whole step, down glides from one step's voltage to the next.

inputs.text: The clock that advances the sequencer, one step on each rising edge.
Applies whichever effect the switch has selected while this is high.

outputs.text: The voltage of the step the sequencer is on.
A gate on each step, as long as that step's own length setting.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
Nothing moves until a clock is patched into CLK; with the jack empty the sequencer holds on its first step.
